settings.deleteDesc: Deleting this environment will permanently destroy all its data and containers. This action cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Environment
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.

domain.title: Custom Domain
domain.step1: Enter the subdomain you want to use (e.g. odoo.mycompany.com).
domain.step2: Click "Add domain" — we'll show you the CNAME target to configure.
domain.step3: Go to your DNS provider and add a CNAME record pointing your subdomain to the target shown.
domain.step4: Come back and click "Verify" once the record is saved. DNS changes can take a few minutes to propagate.
domain.dnsRecord: Add this record in your DNS provider
domain.name: Name
domain.domainActive: Your domain is active and pointing correctly to this environment.

provisionDialog.title: New Development Environment
provisionDialog.defaultBranchDesc: Uses the repository's default branch. No branch is created.
provisionDialog.neutralizeDesc: Disables scheduled actions, emails, and external integrations. Recommended for development.
provisionDialog.branchTaken: That branch exists already: pick it under «Existing branch» or use another name.
provisionDialog.neutralizeOff: With real data, the environment could email customers and run integrations.

workers.title: Workers
workers.movedToResources: Set on the project's resources, beside the memory its server has.

intro.shell: An isolated terminal next to this environment, with its code and its database. Type `dooservice` to see what you can do.
intro.claude: Claude Code on this environment: it configures Odoo and, when code is needed, proposes it before writing it in the repository. With your own account; the sign-in lasts as long as the session.
intro.opencode: opencode on this environment: it configures Odoo and, when code is needed, proposes it before writing it in the repository. With your own provider; the sign-in lasts as long as the session.

console.mustBeRunning: The environment must be running to open a console.
console.productionNotYet: This server needs a newer agent to open the console on production.
console.lost: The connection to the server was lost. You can open another console.

ended.abandoned: The session was closed because this page stopped responding.
ended.idle: The session was closed after 30 minutes without activity.

console.loginRequested: Your browser did not let the sign-in page open. Open it from here.
console.notReady: The console is not ready for Odoo {{version}} on this server yet: its tools are still downloading, or do not exist for that version yet.

exposure.title: Publish on the internet
exposure.explanation: This server is on the customer's network, so its environments only answer inside it. Published, the same domain answers from outside too, without changing anything in their network.
exposure.exposed: This environment now answers from the internet
exposure.withdrawn: This environment answers on the customer's network only again
exposure.tlsStaysHere: The certificate and its private key never leave this server: traffic is encrypted end to end and nothing opens it on the way.
exposure.nothingDialsIn: No port has to be opened on the customer's router and nothing changes in their network: the server reaches out.
exposure.unavailable: Publishing is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes; if it persists, get in touch.
exposure.whatIsVisible: From outside, only the name asked for, the time and the visitor's address are visible; not the contents.

image.when: It is applied at the next deploy, or in the maintenance hours after two weeks.
image.requestedDetail: The environment restarts in a few minutes. If it does not start, it goes back to the one it had.
image.failed: Could not apply the new revision

productionConsole.intro: Real data. Opening it makes a backup; until it is done, read only.
productionConsole.backupFailed: The backup failed: this session only reads.
productionConsole.policyHint: Applies to the whole organization. Each person’s access to the production console is set in Members.
productionConsole.allowAiHint: The AI will be able to read your customers’ real data, which is sent to each user’s AI provider. It only changes data through Odoo and after your confirmation.
productionConsole.notAllowed: You don't have the production console in this project. You can work on a copy: neutralized data, it deletes itself after 24 h.

dataSource.noBackups: There are no full backups yet.

picker.fullOnly: Full backups only: database and attachments.
